## New features
* Switch to [Platformer (2.1 Fork)](https://mods.factorio.com/mod/platformer-fork) for Factorio 2.1 compatibility (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/84)

## Improvements
* Sync client with Archipelago 0.6.8 Factorio Client (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/78)
* Make all instances of a recipe progressive instead of only the first one (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/82)

## Fixes
* Only send items to first platforms instead of all of them, this fix a crash when a platform was destroyed and makes more sense overall (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/81)
* Fix crash when item or player names contains quotes (https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/pull/77)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lepideble/factorio-apworld/compare/platformer-0.4.6...platformer-0.5.0
